subject.title: Feature Request: Voice Recognition / Speaker Identification for Voice Interface

question: Should OpenClaw add speaker enrollment and speaker-gated voice input, and should that contract live in native core, provider/plugin APIs, or be deferred?
rationale: The request changes who can trigger voice actions and how sensitive voice-profile data is stored or sent, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary or fallback policy.

options.title: Design speaker-gate contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define enrollment, local storage, threshold/fallback, provider egress, and native/realtime API ownership before implementation.

options.title: Limit to provider/plugin research
options.body: Keep core voice capture unchanged unless a missing plugin or provider API is proven and design the smallest extension seam first.

options.title: Defer speaker gating
options.body: Explicitly leave current wake-word, push-to-talk, and Talk behavior unchanged until stronger demand or security requirements justify the complexity.

recommendation.title: Design speaker-gate contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define enrollment, local storage, threshold/fallback, provider egress, and native/realtime API ownership before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across macOS Voice Wake, push-to-talk, Talk handoff, and realtime voice surfaces affected by the decision.
